text.tspan: Mira the fox looking down sadly while rabbits peek from burrows
and birds clutch their nests, soft watercolor. Characters: MIRA:
a small young orange fox cub (#e67e22) with a white chest tuft
(#f5f5f0), big amber eyes, fluffy tail, pink button nose
(#f1948a), wearing a tiny red scarf (#c0392b), friendly worried
expression. soft watercolor children's book illustration, warm
muted palette, rounded friendly shapes, gentle rim lighting,
hand-painted paper texture, cozy storybook mood, no text.
blue #3d5a73. character colors: mira fur #e67e22, mira chest
tuft #f5f5f0, mira scarf #c0392b, mira nose #f1948a. leave the
lower third as calm, low-detail negative space for caption text;
keep characters clear of that zone.
